time_split: Frozen response_followup calendar midpoint and exact first-window meal membership; no retuning
dates: Frozen unique-connection complete reference dates with raw15min coverage>=0.90; actual local DST day length
Mean: Arithmetic mean of finite eligible15min grid readings; mg/dL
SDw: Unweighted arithmetic mean of daily sampleSDs on eligible grid dates; mg/dL; ddof1

MODD15.definition: Pooled mean absolute glucose differences at same15min local clock points on truly adjacent calendar dates
MODD15.dst_policy: Exclude both23h and25h dates from MODD pairs; do not bridge across excluded dates
MODD15.relationship_to_prior_proxy: Recomputed actual glucose differences, not clock-bin availability counts

x: Each participant's equal-meal mean of frozen first-window net/peak/positive responses; positive missing if any eligible first-window meal lacks it
primary_y: Late-window new grid metric only; all interpolation support readings at/after cut
comparison_y: Full eligible-date metric under identical new recipe, contains late dates and may overlap early meal reads
paired_difference: OLS of (lateY-fullY) on identical X/covariates/persons/scales with HC3; accounts for paired covariance
scaling: Reference mean/sampleSD of earlyX and full-gridY in source_primary complete paired cohort for each X/Y; shared by joint and all3 targets; no old Z outcome substitution, clipping or log transformation
inference: One row and equal weight per participant; frozen OLS HC3/t interval implementation; minimum50 people and30 residual df; all failed specs retained

families.method: BH separately for each fixed24-row family across both overlapping settings; unestimated slots included in denominator
